instructions: Based on the recent conversation, does the latest speaker want the listener to respond now, with enough intent to begin a useful answer?

criteria.true: A new request or contextual follow-up has clear intent. Imperatives, ellipsis and unfinished grammar qualify when the main request is already understandable.
criteria.false: No response is requested: narration, an answer, acknowledgement, mere quotation, withdrawal or explicit waiting. Also wait if essential intent is still unknown. Handled requests are background only.
